notes:
Source is a 温活 (warming-lifestyle) article. Warming attributions come from (a) the 6-row category table at L62-82 headed 体を温める食材一覧（カテゴリ別） with L59 stating 体を温める食材は薬膳の考え方に基づき「陽性食品」と分類されます, (b) the per-category prose sections L84-105, and (c) the summary line L193. Cooling attributions come from the ⚠️ 体を冷やしやすい食材 box at L150-159 (with L154 explicitly using 陰性食品) and the FAQ at L191.

Category/umbrella labels coded per instruction: 根菜, 冬野菜, 薬味, 香味野菜, 発酵食品, スパイス, たんぱく質, ナッツ, 青魚, 夏野菜, 南国の果物. Note たんぱく質 is a nutrient word used as a table category inside the warming list — flagged in case the study wants nutrient-categories excluded.

FLAGGED / judgment calls:
1. アイス (L155) coded cool as a named food under the 体を冷やしやすい食材 header, but it sits in the same bullet as 冷たい飲み物 and its stated mechanism is 胃腸を直接冷やす (serving temperature). Reasonable to reclassify as a serving-temperature item at adjudication.
2. 白砂糖・精製食品 (L157) coded cool from the box header only; the explanatory arrow talks about blood-sugar swings affecting 血行・体温調節, not a 五性 nature.
3. NOT coded — prepared beverages/products per §8 precedent: 白湯 and 生姜湯 (L184), 生姜入りドリンク (L173, described as 手軽な体温め飲み物), and the convenience-store product forms at L163-172 (ゆで卵, サラダチキン, カップ味噌汁, 即席スープ, サバ缶, いわし缶, ミックスナッツ) which are product forms of already-coded foods under the header コンビニで手に入る温活食材・メニュー.
4. NOT coded — nutrient-source recommendation lists with no nature attribution: レバー/ほうれん草/小松菜/あさり/ひじき as iron (L116, L137), アボカド as vitamin E (L130, L140), バナナ/ほうれん草/じゃがいも as potassium (L133, L143), パプリカ/ブロッコリー/レモン as vitamin C (L118, L135), きのこ/海藻 as 食物繊維 (L146). Note バナナ appears in one of these warming-context lists (L133) yet is explicitly coded cool at L153 — confirming these nutrient lists are not nature attributions.
5. NOT coded — 紅茶・コーヒー・ヨーグルト (L99) mentioned only as vehicles for sprinkling cinnamon; ジンジャーエール (L173) explicitly excluded by the source.
6. No neutral (平/中庸) attributions anywhere in this source.
